key_findings: FIELD COMPARISON (all with same ts_zscore/group_rank/ts_mean20/subindustry/w=40 wrapper): marketimpactscore sh0.96 >> confidence 0.33 > net_prob 0.44 > prob_pos 0.07 > novelty -0.14. marketimpactscore is THE only productive field in news104.

convex5+w=30 COMBO (YPgRK1Kl): NEW BEST rn_sh1.20, asi_jpn+0.22. Combines convex5-inside normalization with short outer window. But sh0.88 (slightly lower than w=40 base 0.96). Tradeoff: shorter outer improves asi_jpn/rn_sh but hurts sh.
convex7 vs convex5: nearly identical results (sh0.88/0.88, rn_sh1.17/1.20, asi_jpn+0.20/+0.22). Power 5 is sufficient.
novelty field: NEGATIVE overall (sh-0.14) but asi_jpn+0.51 (highest JPN positive). Suggests novelty mean-reverts in JPN but not overall.
ts_av_diff: CATASTROPHIC (44% turnover, like ts_rank). Confirms ts_mean is unique smoothing operator; deviation/rank alternatives fail.

OUTER WINDOW TRADEOFF confirmed: w=25 -> sh0.69/asi_jpn+0.28; w=30 -> sh0.82/asi_jpn+0.17; w=40 -> sh0.96/asi_jpn-0.02; w=60 -> sh1.01/asi_jpn-0.27. SHORTER=JPN better but sh lower. No window simultaneously solves sh and asi_jpn.
